content.short: On Predict, a BNB Chain prediction market, the money backing an open bet keeps earning yield until the result is in.
content.description: Predict lets users trade outcomes in crypto prices, sports, politics and culture through binary or multi-outcome markets. Unlike most prediction markets, the collateral behind open positions earns yield while it waits for a result. Markets resolve through UMA, and Chainlink data powers short crypto price markets. Predict is the prediction market partner for Binance Wallet. Predict launched in 2025, earns yield on open positions through Venus Protocol, and is UMA's favoured prediction market partner on BNB Chain. It also supports block trades and maker rebates.
